mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is a clear and cold 26 degrees, feeling like 19, with a waxing crescent moon shining bright over Verona City Hall.
The city has released updated recreation league standings for both men's and coed teams, and there are several new public notices regarding the fall and spring elections.
We have a busy weekend ahead starting with the Dane County Farmer's Market today, followed by the Music of John Denver at the High School Fine Arts Center tomorrow.
In our weekly report, officers noted that on October 25, a 40-year-old man was taken into custody for an O W I offence after being found stopped at the intersection of Plympton and Rita.
You can look forward to the delicious Caramel Cashew flavor today, and the restaurant will be ready for you when it opens today at 10:00 AM.
